summary.en: Body ache, especially back and legs, with vitamin D of 11. Uprise D3 60K one sachet in milk once a week (every Sunday) for eight weeks, never daily, and Becosules on alternate days after breakfast for a month; stop Combiflam. Sit in the sun 15 to 20 minutes daily, repeat vitamin D after two months.
